summary: Backend testing for JOBBY (Modello D on-demand marketplace). Wrote pytest suite /app/backend/tests/test_jobby_backend.py covering seeded providers, auth 401 guards, invalid session_token, Modello D matching (mission -> bot auto-accept in 2-9s), select -> booking with 15% jobby_fee, provider incoming/accept/decline, complete + review updates rating, and earnings aggregation. 10/10 tests passed against the public preview URL.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py has no health/root endpoint; a lightweight GET /api/health would help liveness probes.
POST /api/bookings/{id}/complete does not authorize by customer/provider ownership — any authenticated user could mark any booking completed. Consider adding ownership check.
POST /api/bookings/{id}/review does not verify the caller is the booking's customer, nor that the booking is completed, nor prevent duplicate reviews (reviewed flag exists but is not checked).
POST /api/missions/{id}/select does not check that the caller is the mission's customer; a different authenticated user could book someone else's mission.
GET /api/missions/{id} has no ownership check — any authenticated user can read any mission (may or may not be desired).
server.py is a single 470-line file — acceptable now but split into routers (auth, missions, bookings, providers) if it grows.
Uses deprecated FastAPI @app.on_event('startup'/'shutdown'); consider lifespan context manager.
seed_data_creation: Tests insert transient TEST_ users + user_sessions directly in Mongo (test_database) to obtain Bearer tokens, and clean up (users, sessions, missions, bookings, reviews) at end of each test/class. Bot providers seeded by backend startup were used as-is.
context_for_next_testing_agent: BASE_URL taken from frontend/.env EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL (https://jobby-mvp-update.preview.emergentagent.com). Auth = Emergent Google OAuth; to test protected endpoints, insert users + user_sessions in Mongo directly (see _mk_user helper). Bot auto-accept runs asyncio.create_task with random 2-9s delay — wait up to 15s in polling loop. Booking math: labor + 15% fee (jobby_fee = round(labor*0.15,2), total = labor+jobby_fee).
rca_of_issue: N/A — all 10 tests green. Only code-review remarks provided (missing ownership checks on booking/mission mutation endpoints) — not blocking MVP but should be tightened before real users.
